LanguageData.VFEI2_Swarmling.description: The juvenile form of insectoids, swarmlings are more or less harmless, slow and easy to kill. After some time has passed, they undergo a metamorphosis, forming a cocoon from which an adult insectoid will emerge. There is no way to tell what kind of insect will crawl out of its cocoon.
